connector.name: Paper Distill MCP
connector.registryDescription: Academic paper search across 11 sources with AI curation, ranked push, Zotero and Obsidian support.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package paper-distill-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the eclipse-cj account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
